title: Relative differentials of a smooth morphism are locally free of rank d
statement: Let f:X\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is smooth of relative dimension d [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] for an integer d\ge0. Let \Omega^1_{X/S} be the \mathcal O_X-module whose restriction to affine opens U=\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq X and V=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S with f(U)\subseteq V is the sheaf associated with the A-module \Omega_{A/R} of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Then \Omega^1_{X/S} is locally free of constant rank d [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module].

source.place: Tag 02G1 (morphisms-lemma-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free): Omega_{X/S} finite locally free with rank_x = dim_x(X_{f(x)}), here = d

proof.text: Fix a point x in X. Since f is smooth of relative dimension d, the definition [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] gives dim_x(X_{f(x)}) = d. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-differentials-free-rank-fibre-dimension] to f and x. It supplies affine opens V = Spec R in S and W = Spec A in X with x in W and f(W) contained in V such that the Kähler differential module Omega_{A/R} is free of rank dim_x(X_{f(x)}), hence free of rank d.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G1 (lemma-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free), statement and proof on affine neighbourhoods

proof.text: On each affine neighbourhood W = Spec A obtained in step 1, the definition of Omega^1_{X/S} in the item identifies its restriction with the sheaf associated to Omega_{A/R}. Since Omega_{A/R} is free of rank d, that associated sheaf is O_W^{oplus d}. Thus every point of X has an open neighbourhood on which Omega^1_{X/S} is O^{oplus d}, which is exactly locally free of constant rank d by [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module].
